Home › Security & GDPR

Your data stays in France.
Full stop.

custovox.ai was designed from day one with one principle: your customer data belongs to you, not to us.

🇫🇷

Hosted in France

Your data is hosted exclusively on French servers (OVH infrastructure). A secure individual deposit link is provided to each client after subscription, so your files never transit through third-party services outside the EU.

🔒

Never used to train models

Your data is used solely to produce your analyses. It is never used to train, fine-tune or improve custovox.ai models. Ever.

⏱️

Defined retention periods

We apply clear, contractual retention periods:

  • Free analysis: 30 days after report delivery
  • Active subscription: duration of contract + 30 days
  • Longitudinal option: 24 rolling months
  • After cancellation: 30 days to retrieve your data, then permanent deletion

Immediate deletion guaranteed within 72 hours on written request.

📋

GDPR-compliant by design

custovox.ai is published by a French company (SASU). Our processing is governed by French and European law. A Data Processing Agreement (DPA) is available on request from Scale plan onwards.

Need a DPA for your legal team?

A Data Processing Agreement (DPA) compliant with GDPR Article 28 is available on request from Scale plan onwards. Write to us and we will send it within 2 business days.

Request the DPA → Available from Scale plan · Response within 2 business days

Technical security measures

  • Data encrypted in transit (TLS/HTTPS)
  • French servers — OVH infrastructure
  • Access restricted to operations team only
  • No data sent to third-party AI providers
  • Individual secure deposit link per client
  • Permanent deletion within 72h on request
